title: Date 3 with a Fire sign: saying what you want
old_caption: Hinting for weeks is exhausting for both of you. By date three, say what you're looking for and ask what they want. Either honest answer is a good one.

title: Date 1 with an Earth sign: what to ask
old_caption: Rapid-fire questions can feel like a quiz. Earth signs open up when you slow down and ask about real comforts, like their perfect slow Sunday. Let the pauses breathe.

title: Date 2 with an Earth sign: reading it
old_caption: Calm can look like bored when you're nervous. Watch the details instead: they remembered your order, they found the thing you mentioned. That's how earth signs say they care.

title: Date 3 with an Earth sign: saying what you want
old_caption: "Let's see where it goes" only works for so long. Tell them you like where this is heading and the pace you'd like, then ask for theirs. Clarity feels safe to an earth sign.

title: Date 1 with an Air sign: what to ask
old_caption: Small talk about the weather rarely gets anyone excited. Ask an air sign something playful, like what class they'd teach, and follow wherever the tangent goes.

title: Date 2 with an Air sign: reading it
old_caption: One short reply is not a verdict on the whole date. Listen for "we should go to..." instead. Air signs often flirt by planning the next time.

title: Date 3 with an Air sign: saying what you want
old_caption: You don't need a big speech to be honest. Tell them you like this, say there's no rush, and leave space for their answer. Light and clear goes a long way with air signs.

title: Date 1 with a Water sign: what to ask
old_caption: Asking about their last relationship on date one can close a door before it opens. Ask who makes them feel at home instead, and listen longer than feels natural.

title: Date 2 with a Water sign: reading it
old_caption: If they shared one small true thing, that matters more than you might think. Don't push for the whole story. Notice the opening and keep it safe.

title: Date 3 with a Water sign: saying what you want
old_caption: Hoping they'll just know how you feel puts the whole job on them. Say it gently, then ask how they're feeling. Soft and clear is still brave. Save this for date three.
